text:
omar: Heads up — I sketched an API v2 'stitch' plan for incremental rollout across regions. Need owners for lane-a (control-plane changes), lane-b (SDK changes), and a small canary lane.

rachel: I can take lane-a (control plane). timeline? :calendar:

omar: thanks. target milestone is next Tue 12:00 UTC for an initial gated rollout. key deps: schema migration, proxy header forwarding, and the shim in the legacy gateway.

simon: I'll pick up lane-b (SDK). planning a patch release tomorrow morning. Need a 1-line breaking-change note for the changelog.

lina: can we avoid a breaking change? maybe keep both headers accepted and prefer new one via flag.

simon: yep that's the plan — feature-flagged header acceptance + fallback. no forced client update.

kevin: QA: canary traffic profile? I can run a smoke with 1% production traffic for 2h. Will need the canary route and secrets from infra.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: job_id=canary-286771-smoke.status=queued

omar: kevin — can you confirm you have the canary route? ping infra if not.

kevin: infra confirmed. route name: api-stitch-canary-us-west. I have the secrets.

rachel: control-plane checklist:
- db migration safe flag
- routing policy 'stitch' added
- telemetry tag 'v2.stitch'

simon: SDK checklist:
- patch bumped to 1.4.3
- integration tests updated
- changelog line: "Accepts X-Stitch header; fallbacks supported"

lina: small note for security review: ensure header parsing uses strict sanitizer to avoid header injection.

omar: good call. assign sec-owner? @lina you're on review.

lina: will do, aiming EOD.

kevin: starting canary in ~30m, will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Canary job started: job_id=canary-286771-smoke.status=running

kevin: quick smoke — 200 OKs for 99.8% of requests, token latency within SLOs. No 500s seen in the gateway.

simon: pushing SDK patch now to canary. PR: https://git.redwood/s/simon/sdk-stitch-canary

rachel: control-plane flags toggled to canary lane. telemetry showing v2.stitch events.

omar: excellent. next steps: if canary stable for 2h, promote to 10% across regions then schedule full slice next Tue. owners: control-plane=rachel, sdk=simon, qa=kevin, security=lina. I'll document in the migration playbook.

kevin: noted. will monitor and report any regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary job completed: job_id=canary-286771-smoke.status=success.duration=42m

omar: thanks everyone. if anything blocks, drop notes here and I'll re-route. :thumbsup:
